newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 650 retail money market mutual funds fell $3.83 billion to $612.94 billion in the week ended Dec. 24, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 395 taxable money market funds in the retail category fell $2.56 billion to $500.73 billion, while assets of the 255 tax-exempt funds fell $1.27 billion to $112.21 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 316 institutional money market funds rose $265.7 million to $300.22 billion. Of these, the 253 taxable money market fund assets rose $1.03 billion to $269.38 billion, while assets of the 63 tax-exempt funds fell $762.6 million to $30.83 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $913.16 billion in the week. Assets in the previous week were revised to $916.72 billion from $916.91 billion.
